Update ver 2.0.3 (build 2026061800000)
Release date : JUNE 18, 2026

update : Support TRACKSAT FROM=ALT=deg trigger.
         SPICE Toolkit integration

ALERT : We will run out of 5-digit catalog numbers at 69999 not 99999, which is estimated to occur around 2026‑07‑12 (we're currently at 69635). At that point, newly cataloged objects will have 6-digit catalog numbers of 100000+ and GP data will not be available for them using the TLE format.

Please refer to celestrak.org for additional detail about orbital elements dataset format changes.
https://celestrak.org/NORAD/documentation/gp-data-formats.php
